items.summary: Risk disposition: conditional for ordinary reversible fleet growth; blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch. Compliance is a technical baseline, not legal certification: 37 sites pass, 16 fail, and 6 are unknown, with open banner, consent, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. Analytics and revenue gaps do not independently block ordinary growth, but no unsupported legal, revenue, ROI, attribution, or security claims are permitted. SearchWoot must remain private because source rights, privacy, security, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete.

Launch-readiness progress: no task is closed. All four SearchWoot tasks remain open because the required evidence is not attached. The next evidence actions are: prepare an unsent Woot permission request and counsel packet; produce a repository/configuration data-flow and retention table; capture deployed consent, withdrawal, and GA4 settings; and inventory logs, vendors, retention, access, incident, and data-request procedures.

Revenue evidence is partial and must remain unattributed where the provider supplies only an aggregate row: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission for 2026-09-21, with all commission in the aggregate tracking row. Do not allocate it by clicks or site share. AI usage is $921.96 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-25; cost, margin, and ROI are not calculable because periods and cost coverage do not align.

Site and operations evidence supports only conditional growth: 39 live sites, 19 scaffold sites, 39 analytics-configured sites, 37 GSC-ready sites, and unavailable fleet-doctor and operations sweeps. Private or unreachable sites require a concrete launch decision and checklist before exposure. Missing telemetry is not treated as zero and does not by itself block reversible growth.

items.title: cro-2026-09-25-markitdown-content-prototype
items.summary: No legal blocker to isolated research on the stated MIT evidence, but this is not adoption approval. Preserve license and bundled-asset evidence, avoid trademark or copyright claims, and require CTO security, dependency, performance, accessibility, measurement, and rollback review before any implementation.

items.title: cro-2026-09-25-shadcn-component-prototype
items.summary: Conditional research only. The stated MIT evidence supports a fixture-only prototype, not production use. Require license, asset, trademark, dependency, security, accessibility, performance, measurement, and rollback evidence before adoption.

items.title: cfo-2026-09-25-attribution-reconciliation
items.summary: Report-only reconciliation is permissible using existing evidence, provided aggregate commission remains unattributed, missing costs remain unknown, and no financial, ROI, or causal claim is made.

items.title: cfo-2026-09-25-ai-cost-to-learn-review
items.summary: Report-only review is permissible. Do not treat call volume, token volume, impressions, repository stars, or opportunity scores as financial outcomes or justification for new spend.

items.title: cfo-2026-09-25-infrastructure-cost-coverage-gap
items.summary: Report-only cost-coverage inventory is permissible. Missing cost fields must remain unknown and allocation rules require owner approval before margin reporting.
